title: NetworkFollowWriteRequest
description: network.follow-write-request@1 (ADR-030 step 4; capability network.follows.write): a first-party product records a follow or unfollow on a person's behalf, where they pressed the button. PUT /internal/follows/:type/:target { follower, notify_email?, notify_push? } follows (idempotent; flags change a follow). DELETE /internal/follows/:type/:target?follower=usr_… unfollows (idempotent). Answers network.follow-status-result@1 for the follower. Network emits network.follow.* as for a person's own change.
